description: The signature of the transaction that transferred the token
name: tx_signature

description: The timestamp from when the token data was retrieved
name: retrieval_timestamp

description: True if the token is an NFT, false otherwise
name: is_nft

description: The mint account of the token
name: mint

description: The account with the authority to update the token
name: update_authority

description: A URI to an external JSON that provides information about the token
name: uri

description: The fee that the seller is charged when the token is traded. Value is in basis points
name: seller_fee_basis_points

fields.description: The address of the creator's account
fields.name: address

fields.description: The verification status of the creator
fields.name: verified

fields.description: The proportion of ownership (as a percentage) that this creator has over the token
fields.name: share

description: True if the token has had its primary sale, false otherwise
name: primary_sale_happened

description: True if the token can be modified after its creation, false otherwise
name: is_mutable
